visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static shot of a white rolling storage cart positioned next to a white wall. On top of the cart sits a large green palm plant, a black spray bottle, and several white pillar candles. (2) A hand reaches into the frame and pulls open multiple shallow drawers of the cart, which are filled with a dense collection of colorful makeup palettes and cosmetic items. (3) A young woman with short black hair appears on screen, wearing a grey zip-up hoodie and a white fuzzy bunny ear headband. She looks directly at the camera and gestures with her hands while speaking. (4) A close-up shot shows a rectangular four-pan eyeshadow palette with a rose-gold and burgundy casing; the hand tilts the palette to show the reflecting light on the shimmer powders. (5) The woman's arm is shown as she applies four distinct swatches of the eyeshadow—ranging from a pale champagne to a deep reddish-brown—onto her skin to demonstrate the pigment. (6) The camera provides a close-up of the woman's eye as she uses various makeup brushes to carefully apply the eyeshadow to her lids and lower lash line. (7) Close-up shots of a MAC single eyeshadow pot and a pink Heroine Make eyeliner pen are shown as she completes the eye makeup routine. (8) The woman presents her final look, smiling and making a peace sign toward the camera while holding the original palette.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: My favorite eyeshadow palette. (2) [Subtitle]: 如果只能有一盒眼影的話 我會選這一個 今天分享我旅行必帶的眼影盒. (3) [Logo]: CHARLOTTE TILBURY Luxury Eyeshadow Palette. (4) [Subtitle]: 這一盒顏色超好看的 重點是它有深有淺 有臥蠶色 然後它的打亮非常水潤. (5) [Subtitle]: 我愛它愛到櫃子裡有庫存 就是一模一樣的顏色有兩盒. (6) [Subtitle]: 可以先刷中間色的珠光 珠光色塗滿上眼窩及下眼尾. (7) [Subtitle]: 霧面棕色從眼尾開始往前暈. (8) [Subtitle]: 再用眼線刷沾深色 貼緊睫毛根部畫眼線及眼頭 下眼瞼. (9) [Subtitle]: 暈一暈 沾點臥蠶色 這個臥蠶色非常飽和 一刷就有很自然地臥蠶了. (10) [Slogan]: MAC Matte Eyeshadow-Omega. (11) [Subtitle]: 然後可以用MAC的Omega單色眼影 加臥蠶陰影 非常自然. (12) [Subtitle]: 最後畫龍點睛最重要的一筆來了 用手沾這一顆 這個亮片有水潤光澤感 超美的哦. (13) [Subtitle]: 點綴在眼皮中央 放一點點在眼珠正下方 這樣就會亮亮的. (14) [Subtitle]: 先貼個睫毛 夾睫毛. (15) [Logo]: ISEHAN Kiss Me Heroine Make Prime Liquid Eyeliner. (16) [Subtitle]: 然後畫個眼線. (17) [Variety]: 完妝!. (18) [Subtitle]: 非常自然 每一天都適合 很百搭的一款 棕色調的眼影. (19) [Subtitle]: 超喜歡的 分享給你們囉.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a mid-tempo, bright acoustic guitar and piano theme. A distinct mechanical click and rustle are heard as the storage drawers are opened. (2) A female voice enters with high energy and a friendly tone, speaking Chinese fluently and rapidly. The BGM ducks slightly to allow the narration to dominate. (3) A 'ding' sound effect triggers a transition as she introduces the eyeshadow palette. (4) The speaker provides a step-by-step instructional narrative with clear articulation. Occasional 'pop' sound effects emphasize key moments in the makeup application. (5) The speaker concludes with a positive, rising vocal inflection, and the music swells briefly before a hard cut at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Evidence -> Tutorial -> Result -> Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a beauty tutorial and product endorsement for the Charlotte Tilbury eyeshadow palette. The creator shares her genuine enthusiasm for the product, demonstrates its versatility through a live application tutorial, and provides specific tips on how to achieve a natural yet enhanced eye look using complementary products from MAC and Kiss Me.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly labels the product as her 'favorite,' shows brand logos clearly, and provides a detailed instructional guide on its usage.
